description: Find paid Amazap tasks by keyword. Results: price, value (est. saving), buy call.

buyable_only.description: Hide SKUs that are not buyable yet, including USDC coming-soon rows. Default true. Pass false to see them. Buyable rows still rank first.

cursor.description: Page cursor from the previous search. When set, it overrides offset.

include_demo.description: Include synthetic demo SKUs. Default false.

include_unhealthy.description: Include paused SKUs and untested SKUs with a generic schema. Default false.

limit.description: How many SKUs to return. Default 8, maximum 20. (minimum 1).

offset.description: How many matching SKUs to skip. Use nextCursor from the previous page when it is present. (minimum 0).

protocol.description: Optional filter: L402, x402 for Lightning x402, or usdc.

query.description: Keywords or a short description of what you want to buy.

region.description: ISO country code. Matches coverage that includes it or is global. Unknown coverage stays in the results, ranked lower.

name: search_catalog

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.

title: Search catalog
